protocol.range_label: 采集±3cm；测试±3/4/5/6cm，方向条带各4点
protocol.duration_label: 实际30Hz；7.5物理秒；ACT每次预测4步后逐步执行
protocol.note: 独立16个新位置，各档4个方向条带点；不是全均匀方盒成功率估计。与旧4点及冻结正式位置均不同，使用同一权重和source_reset0。三档扩大测试均实测在采集±3cm之外；实际30Hz、7.5秒、ACT预测4/执行4。没有增加训练种子，未用结果选择权重。

ACT_run.metric_note: 独立16点抓取11/16，终点20mm分量8/16。四档抓取4/4、4/4、2/4、1/4；终点20mm为4/4、4/4、0/4、0/4。+2/+3cm保存姿态检出手/末端与目标表面交叉，未通过完整视觉或Spatial SSR；终点分量不是完整SSR。原48段视频和336帧抽查已复核；不与旧4点或重置对照合并。

independent_position_sampling: Four new directions per cohort; outer cohorts uniformly sampled within directional strips beyond3cm, not a full uniform-box estimate.
metric_scope: Directional strips4 per cohort, same selected model and training seed; no pooling with prior4; terminal20mm is not fullSSR.
geometry_scope: Authored hand/EEF/target surfaces at actual30Hz policy inputs and terminal; no certification for unsaved120Hz, collider volumes, other robot/scene geometry or renderer/materials. Endpoint separation is not physical penetration depth.

observations: All11original successful tags correspond to visible lifts; two+2cm successes and+3cm success still miss20mm, failures preserved.
Failed10 opens/repositions nearend;11 liftslate;13/14/15 remain near table.
Amberglass stays visibly rendered in reviewed frames, no conspicuous wholeobject opaquewhite; successful late lifts leavechest FOV while head/third retainobject.
Target/finger contact locallyoccluded; CPU authoredmesh crossings at+2/+3cm mean fullvisual/penetration acceptance remains false regardless sampledappearance.

source50_geometry.limitation: Authored surface diagnostic at saved30Hz poses only; no proof for unsaved substeps, collider volumes, materials, renderer subdivision, other robot links or full paper SpatialSSR.

source50_sampled_visual.findings: Clear vessel/table marks visible before lift. All4 chest-camera samples near4.97/5.00s show conspicuous nearly-white lifted beaker; head camera retains transparent contour. Late lift exits chest view. Finger/object contact occluded; geometry diagnostic separate.

progress.note: 同一棕色250ml ACT的独立16点：抓取11/16（68.75%），终点20mm分量8/16；完整Spatial SSR与视觉未通过，正式仍0/21对象、0/42方法。
